methodology.order: alternating baseline/candidate and candidate/baseline each round
methodology.warmup: 8 x 64KiB ranges + one64MiB transfer per process
methodology.source: repeated random256KiB block, filesystem cache warm; all bytes consumed, exact lengths checked
methodology.server: real HttpApp + ServeFile + logging serialization to discard sink; grant authorization uses fixed in-memory metadata (no DB/realpath)
methodology.bridge: production class, native Node, candidate diagnostics enabled
methodology.sampling: 10ms sampled absolute process RSS, CPU user+system deltas
methodology.throughputPolicy: same relaxed rate limits (100000/min and burst10000) for timing; default admission measured separately
methodology.limits: loopback synthetic transport workload, not WAN/GPU/packaged Electron performance; RSS excludes client and OS page cache
